full_name: Andhra Pradesh Eye Disease Study-Visual Function Questionnaire (revised 16-item version)
domains: resolution (reading); contrast sensitivity; illumination; peripheral vision (item subsets, p3-4); two-factor composite of reading and peripheral vision/mobility
response_scale: 0-4 difficulty (0 no difficulty, 1 little, 2 moderate, 3 great deal but can still manage, 4 cannot manage); collapsed to 3 categories after Rasch analysis
scoring: Raw sum; higher = greater difficulty; Rasch-scaled person measures (logits, Andrich rating scale model) via Excel conversion
target_population: visually impaired adults referred for low vision rehabilitation, India
notes: Item reliability 0.99; person separation reliability 0.81 native, 0.80 revised rating scale (Table 7 p7); PCA first contrast: 72% variance, not unidimensional (abstract p1, p4); one misfitting item (item 1 reading small print, infit 1.54); items poorly targeted. Interviewer-administered (p2). Pages 1, 2, 7.
